question: What does the Autel EVO Max 4N do when the control link is lost, and do incident reports match?

intake.focus: loss of control/link behavior (Autel EVO Max 4N)
intake.reason: Question about what Autel EVO Max 4N does on control link loss and whether NASA ASRS incident reports align with that behavior.

brief.short_answer: FAA guidance states that on a loss of control link you should try to reestablish the control link and, if it cannot be reestablished, initiate emergency or contingency procedures; and if control inputs are not synchronized or delayed, discontinue flight. The Autel EVO Max 4N manual says the drone will continue to attempt to reconnect during signal loss, will issue real-time voice alerts when the C2 link is lost, and will execute the configured Signal Loss Action after more than 10 seconds. An unverified incident report claims the UAS completely lost control and flew away with Return To Home failing.

claims.text: When a loss of control link occurs, FAA AC 107-2A states to "Try to reestablish control link connection with the small unmanned aircraft".
claims.quote: Try to reestablish control link connection with the small unmanned aircraft

claims.text: If the control link cannot be reestablished, start emergency or contingency procedures for loss of control link.
claims.quote: If connection cannot be reestablished, start emergency or contingency procedures for loss of control link.

claims.text: When control inputs are not synchronized or delayed, discontinue flight and/or avoid further flight operations until testing of the control link.
claims.quote: Discontinue flight and/or avoid further flight operations until further inspection and testing of the control link between the ground control unit and the aircraft.
conditions: control inputs not synchronized or delayed

claims.text: When signal loss triggers automatic RTH, the drone will continue to attempt to reconnect.
claims.quote: During the execution of automatic RTH caused by signal loss, the drone will continue to attempt to reconnect
conditions: automatic RTH caused by signal loss

claims.text: When the C2 link is lost, the Autel Enterprise App and the remote controller will issue real-time voice alerts.
claims.quote: When the C2 link is lost, both the Autel Enterprise App and the remote controller will issue real-time voice alerts to notify the user.

claims.text: During automated flight missions, if the connection between the drone and the remote controller is lost, the drone will continue flying in its current state until the Autel Enterprise App displays the disconnection message.
claims.quote: During automated flight missions, if the connection between the drone and the remote controller is lost, the drone will continue flying in its current state until the Autel Enterprise App displays the disconnection message.
conditions: connection between the drone and the remote controller is lost

claims.text: The drone will perform the Signal Loss Action you set if the C2 link between the drone and the remote controller is lost for more than 10 seconds.
claims.quote: If the drone battery is low, the Autel Enterprise App will prompt Auto RTH.
conditions: C2 link lost for more than 10 seconds

claims.text: If the link is restored within 10 seconds after disconnection, control will automatically return to the remote controller.
claims.quote: If the link is restored within 10 seconds after disconnection, control will automatically return to the remote controller.
conditions: link is restored within 10 seconds after disconnection

claims.text: The reporter states: "I completely lost control of the UAS" and the platform continued to fly away from me while input into the controls to return, with all attempts of Return To Home features failed.
claims.quote: I completely lost control of the UAS

No explicit mapping of the default Signal Lost Action and default RTH altitude in the Autel EVO Max 4N manual.

C003.rationale: The cited passage directs to discontinue flight and/or avoid further flight operations until testing of the control link when control inputs are not synchronized or delayed.

All attempts of Return To Home features failed.' and 'UAS Platform has not been located or recovered.', matching the claim exactly.
